Remove the hard Existence(has_key); keep Existence(door_open), Precedence(has_key, door_open), and the soft Precedence(door_open, at_goal) with soft Existence(at_goal).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(door_open) hard plus Precedence(has_key, door_open) hard forces picking up the key and its order; the soft Existence(at_goal) and soft Precedence(door_open, at_goal) capture the preferred, ordered goal walk without adding hard requirements.
